text: For D332899 at source revision 269f878aab01978ea1f5295133e3ecba8591a0cb, the author requested less repeated test code, including loops where useful. The AI reports using shared state getters, shared cleanup, and a loop for nine Tab steps across the three Save test files. This supports a scoped preference for clearer, less repetitive tests, not a requirement to loop every test sequence. The report says all 323 assertions and messages remained unchanged, but native tests could not start. The records do not clearly establish acceptance of this individual cleanup: changeAccepted remains false even in the later event titled Author kept a prepared review change.
title: Reduce repetition in Calendar Save tests
